_schema_documentation.description: Registry of shadow strategies for A/B testing against the live (champion) strategy. Each entry has the keys below. Set 'active': false to keep an entry as documentation without running it.

fields.active: boolean. If false, the shadow is documented but not evaluated.
fields.type: Implementation type. Must be a key in SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATIONS. Currently: 'hold_through_rerank', 'rank_window', 'prior_week_filter'.
fields.description: Free-text description of what the shadow is testing.
fields.active_since: YYYY-MM-DD. Only weeks on or after this date are evaluated. Lets you start tracking a hypothesis from a specific cut date.
fields.params: Type-specific parameter overrides (see comments per type).
fields.promotion_criteria: Free-text reference to the pre-registered markdown doc with the promote/retire decision criteria. Required reading before promoting.

hold_through_rerank.behavior: Each week N's top-N picks: hold through weeks N+1, N+2,... as long as the name still ranks in the top-N. Exit at the close of the week it drops out.

rank_window.behavior: Pick top-N from a sliding window of composite_rank positions. E.g. start_rank=4 + top_n=10 means use ranks 4-13.

prior_week_filter.behavior: Filter top-N picks by prior-week return bounds. Picks must satisfy min_prior_return <= return_fri_fri <= max_prior_return.

shadow_hold_through_rerank_v1.description: Hold positions through future weeks if they re-rank in top-10 (composite). Initial 6-week backtest showed +0.32%/wk delta vs champion, win rate 33%, p=0.65. Effect is small and noisy. Activation deferred until consecutive-top-10 events accumulate -- current rate is ~10% (6 of 60 picks), too sparse to evaluate the cadence hypothesis meaningfully. Cadence is independent of the composite_rank formula, so this shadow remains valid after the 2026-06-05 stage 5 fix.

shadow_skip_top_3_v1_SUPPLANTED.description: SUPPLANTED by 2026-06-05 stage 5 patch. Originally drafted to test the rank-crowding hypothesis (use ranks 4-13 instead of 1-10). Initial 6-week backtest showed +1.11%/wk delta vs champion, win rate 83% (5/6 weeks). However, subsequent investigation revealed the rank-crowding pattern was largely an artifact of a bug in pipeline/05_llm_synthesis.py that overwrote stage 4's correct composite_rank (alpha + momentum tiebreaker) with the old 50/50 alpha+EV blend. The stage 5 fix addresses the root cause directly: the broken ranking concentrated picks at high-EV names which underperformed within the top-100. After the fix, the 'top 3' will be momentum-driven and should perform comparably to ranks 4-13. Activating this shadow on top of the stage 5 fix would double-count the intervention. Kept as-is for documentation. Could be revisited if 4-6 weeks of post-fix data still shows rank-crowding in the new ranking.

shadow_v1_prior_week_filter_v1_DEPRECATE.description: DEPRECATED -- 6-week backtest showed -3.79%/wk delta vs champion (worse), p=0.04, win rate 17%. The V1 bounds (-20% to +10%) do not work as filter for V2's Monday-close entry timing. Likely reasons: (a) V2 model already encodes prior-week behavior in composite scoring; (b) V2 entry timing requires different bounds. Could revisit with reversed asymmetry (e.g. -10% to +20%) as a separate shadow. Note: backtest was against the pre-fix broken ranking; post-fix behavior may differ but unlikely to flip the result given the magnitude.
shadow_v1_prior_week_filter_v1_DEPRECATE.promotion_criteria: n/a -- deprecated, see backtest result above
